journey.title: Attach an agent to an external channel
journey.purpose: An agent that already works in the app is given an external handle, with the least-effort available channel offered first and any unavailable channel presented as a requirement to satisfy rather than a dead end.

steps.intent: Decides this agent should be reachable from outside the app.
Sees which channels this host can actually attach, cheapest first.
Reads why an unavailable channel is unavailable and what would fix it.
Receives a first external message on the new handle.

claims.statement: No attach flow can be started that cannot be completed on this host.
claims.rationale: OT-P1-012. Availability is computed from facts the fleet already holds, so a dead end is always avoidable.

claims.statement: The order channels are offered in comes from descriptor data, never from a maintained list.
